traceId.description: Trace id of the request, copied from its traceparent header. Unverified: the client can choose it.

Cart.description: A customer's cart. An absent cart is an empty one with version 0.

available.description: False when the product is inactive or the quantity is more than is in stock

Order.description: A placed order. Prices are the ones at checkout.

expiresAt.description: When the stock held for an unpaid order is given back

description.description: Plain text; line feeds are allowed, tabs and carriage returns are not.
Plain text; line feeds are allowed, tabs and carriage returns are not.

csrfHeader.description: The value of the __Host-XSRF-TOKEN cookie; required on every unsafe request.
csrfHeader.name: X-XSRF-TOKEN

sessionCookie.description: Server-side session cookie set after the OpenID Connect login.
sessionCookie.name: __Host-SESSION

Location.description: Relative URL of the new product

409.description: Conflict: the slug is already taken

404.description: Not Found: unknown or inactive product

409.description: Conflict: the cart already has 20 lines (cart-full)

201.description: Created. A repeated key answers 201 again, with the order's current state and Idempotency-Replayed: true

Idempotency-Replayed.description: true when the key had been used before

409.description: Conflict: cart-changed, price-changed, out-of-stock, too-many-pending-orders, reservation-limit or idempotency-in-progress (with Retry-After)

422.description: Unprocessable: the key was used with a different request (idempotency-key-reused)

404.description: Not Found, also for another customer's order
Not Found, also for another customer's order

409.description: Conflict: the order is not awaiting payment, or its hold had already run out (order-state)
